title: Mechanix Wear
description: mechanix.com 630GB Mechanix Wear American glove maker in Valencia, California, born in 1984 when Jim Hale built a glove for race mechanic Brian Lunnis, and in 1991 launched The Original glove at the Daytona 500, soon adopted by Dale Earnhardt's pit crew and all of NASCAR. Led by CEO Jesse Spungin and backed by private equity firm Gryphon Investors since 2020, it sells over 100 glove models in 20000 retail stores across 70 countries. Its flagship lines include The Original, FastFit and M-Pact impact gloves using TrekDry, D3O, Durahide leather and AX Suede materials. The company runs three divisions, consumer retail, industrial B2B, and tactical and military, holding a GSA contract, NSN catalog and Berry and TAA compliant lines used by US special forces and NATO troops. NASCAR partnership spans 30 years including the Most Valuable Pit Crew award. Under Gryphon it bought Chicago Protective Apparel in 2021, Kinco and Welch in 2025 and OTEX in 2026, building a full PPE platform.
